description: Human-gated phase DAG for a local, synthetic, deterministic evaluation. Exit zero plus attributable evidence is required; only a human may mark a phase passing.

features.name: Build A readiness review
features.behavior: The filled harness is validated and explicitly approved by a human while Claims implementation and executable domain fixtures remain absent.
features.verification: ./init.sh && test -z "$(find claims -type f ! -name '.gitkeep' -print -quit)" && test ! -d security && test ! -e context/SECURITY.md && test ! -e .kiro/steering/security.md && test ! -e .kiro/steering/security-review.md
features.evidence: Record readiness checks and human decision in evaluation/build-a/readiness-review.md; approval is not yet recorded.

features.name: Deterministic Build A implementation
features.behavior: After recorded approval, reviewed synthetic fixtures are processed through validate, normalize, terminal route, and exactly one minimal local result with no prohibited effect.
features.evidence: Record attributable, non-sensitive test evidence in evaluation/build-a/evidence-index.md.

features.name: Build A evaluation and snapshot proposal
features.behavior: A fresh-session evaluation records correctness, local reproducibility, traceability, verification, gaps, and a human-reviewable snapshot proposal without creating Build B.
features.verification: ./init.sh && test -s evaluation/build-a/evidence-index.md && test -s evaluation/build-a/scorecard.md && test -s evaluation/build-a/worked-gaps-backlog.md && test -s evaluation/build-a/snapshot-decision.md
features.evidence: Snapshot creation requires a separate recorded human confirmation after all four dimensions pass.
